name: Artificer
summary: Inventive magical specialists who combine arcane knowledge, crafted tools, and enchanted items.
toolProficiencies: Thieves' tools, tinker's tools, one type of artisan's tools
skillChoices: Choose 2 from Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Sleight of Hand
features:
1 — Magical Tinkering, Spellcasting
2 — Infuse Item
3 — Artificer Specialist, The Right Tool for the Job
5 — Specialist feature
6 — Tool Expertise
7 — Flash of Genius
9 — Specialist feature
10 — Magic Item Adept
11 — Spell-Storing Item
14 — Magic Item Savant
15 — Specialist feature
18 — Magic Item Master
20 — Soul of Artifice
spellcasting: Intelligence-based prepared spellcasting. Artificers use tools as spellcasting focuses and gain access to cantrips and a specialized arcane spell list.
notes: A half-caster focused heavily on magic items, tools, support, and customization through infusions. Individual subclasses can significantly change combat role.
